items.title: Standard builds for existing Pro teams have moved to usage-based billing
items.summary: Existing Pro teams will no longer include a Standard build slot. This brings Standard builds under the same usage-based billing model as other build machines. Standard builds cost $0.014 per build minute, and your monthly usage credit applies to build usage. Billing applies to all projects on the team.See included and Standard build minutes for your team on the .
